The '''''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] design family that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark Empire]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The ''Procursator''-class was involved in multiple fleet gatherings throughout the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], including gatherings of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Dark Empire's stronghold [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], and a New Republic fleet gathering. Two vessels of the class participated in the [[Battle of Calamari]], but were destroyed by New Republic.

==Description==
[[File:Procursatorblownup.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''Procursator'' escorting the ''Allegiance'' is destroyed by New Republic ships.]]
The ''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer was a model of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Part of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] design family, it measured 1,200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="Jason Fry" /> shorter than a standard [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="EGW" /> The ''Procursator''-class was characterized by its dagger-like shape, as well as a [[Conning tower/Legends|conning tower]] where the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] was located in. The tower was placed in the aft section of a wider command section.<ref name="EGW" /> The ''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer utilized three aft [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] for propulsion, and had a ventral [[Solar ionization reactor/Legends|solar ionization reactor]] midship.<ref name="DE3" />It was armed with 3 turrets situated on the mid-axis of the ship, similar to the Imperial and [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|Allegiance-class]]. Like the [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector'']] and ''Allegiance''-class, the ''Procursator''-class lacked ventral hanger bays. The main purpose of this ship was to escort bigger Star Destroyers but also be a flagship for smaller fleets. 

==History==
[[File:Procursator_bow.png|thumb|right|280px|A ''Procursator''s bow. Axial turrets visible.]]
The ''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer was in Imperial service by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] observed three ''Procursator''-class Star Destroyers that were part of a high-mobility fleet. This fleet also included [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class Heavy Star Destroyers]], [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts]], and other vessels. The fleet rendezvoused with [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="EGW" /> At another point, a ship of this class underwent repairs and refurbishment while six [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimators]] flew nearby.<ref name="Repair and Refurbish">{{FFGTCG|set=Balance of the Force|cardname=Repair and Refurbish}}</ref>

Years later, during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], one of these Star Destroyers was seen in formation with a ''Bellator''-class dreadnought and several ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers with Republic markings.<ref name="EGW" /> During the rise of the [[Dark Empire]], two ''Procursator''s escorted the [[Allegiance (Allegiance-class)|''Allegiance'']] at the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. The three ships were assaulted by a New Republic task force and destroyed.<ref name="DE3" /> Around the same time, at least one ''Procursator'' was seen flying alongside a ''Bellator''-class dreadnought among the [[Byss Defense Fleet]].<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This design originated as a [[fanon]] vessel made by [[Ansel Hsiao]] based on "anonymous star destroyer #2",<ref name="Fractalspongecomment2">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=172|text=Stardestroyer.net art thread. Hsiao mentions the inspiration for the design|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/5mRWa}}</ref> a designation applied to ship designs seen in the [[Dark Empire 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series and on the cover of the series' [[Star Wars: Dark Empire (trade paperback)|trade paperback]] by [[Curtis Saxton]] on his [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]] fansite.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/swtc/dagger.html#destroyer2|text=STAR WARS: Warships of the Empire: Catalogue|archivedate=20220709212926}}</ref> The name chosen by the artist for its class is the Latin word for "skirmisher/forward-runner".<ref name="UNDLDAGA">{{WebCite|url=http://www.archives.nd.edu/cgi-bin/lookup.pl?stem=procursa&ending=tor|text=University of Notre Dame Latin Dictionary and Grammar Aid|archiveurl=https://archive.is/2FbT}}</ref>

[[File:HsiaoProcursator.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Ansel Hsiao's model from Fractalsponge.net.]]
When approached by [[Lucas Licensing]] to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in LFL's [[Holocron continuity database]], according to the artist,<ref name="Fractalspongecomment1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&sid=e8501d9d9e2ccc9a1c18226a2628097f&start=1576|text=Stardestroyer.net art thread. The artist Ansel Hsiao (Fractalsponge) mentions LFL putting the names of his submitted designs in the Holocron|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/rLrwa}}</ref> later confirmed by ''Warfare'' author, [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Jason Fry" />

According to Hsiao, the ship appeared not in one of his own pictures for the book, but was used in another artist's painting.<ref name="Fractalspongecomment3">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1623|text=Stardestroyer.net art thread. Ansel Hsiao mentions the ''Procursator''{{'s}} appearance in the book|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/1Rg8P}}</ref> He also designed it from spare parts left over from the ''Bellator''-class dreadnought to see how quickly he could design and build a Star Destroyer. He completed the ship over a weekend, citing its design as being similar to a little "[[Wikipedia:War Emergency Programme destroyers|War Emergency Programme]]-esque no-frills ship".<ref name="explanation">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/3D%20Projects.htm|text=3D Projects: Past, Present, and Future|archivedate=20200116164039}}</ref>

The design can be seen in two paintings, both by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]]. The latter of which uses a picture from Hsiao's personal gallery as a background, where the ship appears, albeit blurred, as well as another ship of the same class being obscured slightly by a TIE Advance X1, as well as a third above an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer, which itself is above and to the right of the aforementioned X1, although significantly farther away from the others.<ref name="Suvudulink">{{Suvudu|url=files/2012/04/Ozzel_Piett.jpg|text=Hsiao's artwork on a Suvudu EGTW art gallery, second Star Destroyer on the lower left side}}</ref><ref name="FSG">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/gallery/images/Strategic%20Reserve.jpg|text=Strategic Reserve|work=[[Ansel Hsiao]]'s [https://fractalsponge.net official website]|archivedate=20260301060638}}</ref>
